title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates | TechCrunch
summary: One of those sources, Ramp, the corporate credit card and expense management company, has just released some surprising new data: OpenAI has started gaining on Anthropic with US businesses. That’s when Anthropic hit 41% market share to OpenAI’s 39%.
